record.title: Permanent Densification of Calcium Aluminophosphate Glasses
claim_notes: Frontiers in Materials 6:63, published 18 April 2019. Copyright 2019 Kapoor, Youngman, Ma, Lönnroth, Rzoska, Bockowski, Jensen, Bauchy and Smedskjaer.
Article-specific CC BY notice on PDF p.13 and publisher HTML link to CC BY 4.0. Retain attribution and the license link.

Changes: selected analyzed oxide compositions and measured density facts transcribed into structured candidate records with source qualifications and explicit unknowns. No author or publisher endorsement is implied.

No separate third-party restriction appears in the inspected Table 1 caption, footnote or selected density-method passage. This selection does not import referenced works or separately credited content.
Selected PDF SHA-256: ca831de841ebc22e52157474e491ca2151d8e4f6d68576a75376af47203d38a0. No PDF, screenshots, full text, figures or raw measurements are redistributed.

product_form.text: As-prepared calcium phosphate or calcium aluminophosphate glass; cut and polished pieces described as about 10 x 10 x 3 mm3.

evidence.locator: PDF p.2, Experimental Section / Sample Preparation, before compression procedure

product_form.notes: General source preparation dimensions; no independent density-specimen count is established.

processing.text: Raw materials calcined at 400 C for 12-16 h; melted in a platinum crucible with an alumina cover at 1100-1500 C for 2-4 h; cast into stainless steel molds, cut, ground and polished.

evidence.locator: PDF p.2, Experimental Section / Sample Preparation, before compression procedure

processing.notes: Source-wide preparation ranges are not exact row-specific melt schedules. Starting reagent purities do not establish final glass purity.

temper_or_heat_treatment.text: Annealed for 2 h at estimated Tg, then reannealed after cutting and grinding for 30 min at measured Tg.

evidence.locator: PDF p.2, Experimental Section / Sample Preparation, before compression procedure

temper_or_heat_treatment.notes: The Table 1 as-prepared state precedes the separate pressure-compression treatment. No row-specific exact thermal schedule or density-test temperature is inferred.

conditioning.notes: Density-specific post-preparation humidity, moisture and conditioning duration are not stated.

reinforcement.notes: Oxide-glass formulations; no reinforcement claim is assigned.

porosity.notes: No quantitative porosity is given; zero porosity is not assumed.

orientation.notes: No directional claim is attached to scalar density; this is not proof of isotropy.

archimedes_density.basis_note: Reported measured density. Neither Table 1 nor the density paragraph explicitly identifies the tabulated central values as arithmetic means; aggregation is not inferred from repeated measurements or the source-wide SD bound.

evidence.locator: PDF p.3, Property Characterization, density paragraph

temperature.notes: The exact numerical temperature is not reported; no 20 C or 25 C default is supplied.

test_standard.notes: No density-test standard is reported. ASTM C598 belongs to the beam-bending viscosity method and is not transferred.

test_method.text: Archimedes method: weighing in air, then suspended in ethanol at room temperature.

evidence.locator: PDF p.3, Property Characterization, density paragraph

test_method.notes: At least 10 repetitions per sample are reported. This is a measurement-repeat lower bound; the independent specimen count and preparation-batch count are not stated.

direction.notes: Loading direction does not apply to scalar density.

conditioning.notes: Density-specific conditioning and humidity are not reported; 50 +/-5% RH in the adjacent paragraph applies to hardness.

loading_rate.notes: Mechanical loading rate does not apply to this density result.

fact.notes: Exact density measurement pressure is not stated; a numerical ambient-pressure value is not inferred.

evidence.locator: PDF p.3, Property Characterization, density paragraph

fact.notes: At least 10 repetitions per sample are reported. This is a measurement-repeat lower bound; the independent specimen count and preparation-batch count are not stated.

archimedes_density.uncertainty_note: The source reports a source-wide maximum standard-deviation bound of <=0.002 g/cm3 (written as +/-0.002 g/cm3); Table 1 gives no individual row standard deviations. The bound is not assigned as six measured SDs, a confidence interval, standard error or zero uncertainty.

sample_count.scope: At least 10 repetitions per sample are reported. This is a measurement-repeat lower bound; the independent specimen count and preparation-batch count are not stated.
sample_count.source_statement: At least 10 repetitions per sample; independent specimen count not stated.

evidence.locator: PDF p.3, Property Characterization, density paragraph

method_definition.definition: Archimedes density by air/ethanol weighing at room temperature. At least 10 repetitions per sample are reported. This is a measurement-repeat lower bound; the independent specimen count and preparation-batch count are not stated.

evidence.locator: PDF p.3, Property Characterization, density paragraph

Source labels qualify these glass formulations; no normalization, analytical correction, certified purity, exact final stoichiometry or molecular-species identity is inferred. Reported zero Al2O3 is a table entry, not proof of absolute absence at every detection limit. Thermal history and repeated measurements qualify states, not new identities.
